name: CloudPanel
description: CloudPanel is a free server control panel for hosting PHP, Node.js, Python, static sites and reverse proxies. It manages NGINX vhosts, PHP-FPM versions, databases, Let's Encrypt certificates, Varnish page cache, cron jobs, SFTP users and backups from one web interface or the clpctl CLI.

notes.text: CloudPanel officially supports virtual machines only, not LXC. This script runs its official installer in an unprivileged container; use a VM if you need vendor support.
Sign in at https://IP:8443 with the admin password saved in ~/cloudpanel.creds inside the container.
Port 8443 is open to everyone by default: limit it to your IPs under Security > Firewall in CloudPanel, or enable Basic Auth with clpctl cloudpanel:enable:basic-auth.
